header.running_head: 3. Belief in the Events after Death...

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ صُهَيْبٍ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: إِذَا دَخَلَ أَهْلُ الْجَنَّةِ الْجَنَّةَ، قَالَ: يَقُولُ اللهُ تَعَالَي: تُرِيدُونَ شَيْئاً أَزِيدُكُمْ ؟ فَيَقُولُونَ : اَلَمْ تُبَيِّضْ وُجُوهَنَا؟ أَلَمْ تُدْخِلْنَا الْجَنَّةَ وَتُنَجِّنَا مِنَ النَّارِ؟ قَالَ: فَيَكْشِفُ الْحِجَابَ، فَمَا أُعْطُوا شَيْئاً أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِمْ مِنَ النَّظَرِ إِلَي رَبِّهِمْ .
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم باب اثبات رؤية المؤمنين في الاخرة...، رقم:٤٤٩
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Suhaib (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said, “When the people of Jannah have entered Jannah, Allah will ask the people of Jannah, “Would you like Me to give you something more?” (Shall I give you something better, beyond what has been given to you so far?) The people of Jannah will say to Allah, “You have made our faces radiant, You have freed us from the Fire and admitted us into Jannah” (what else is there for us to desire?). After this reply of His servants, Allah will remove the veil (after that they will be granted the sight of Allah). Of all the blessings they have received so far, the most beloved and most exalted good fortune is seeing their Lord.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ يَقُولُ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: لَا تَغْبِطُوا فَاجِرًا بِنِعْمَةٍ، إِنَّكَ لَا تَدْرِي مَا هُوَ لَاقٍ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهِ، إِنَّ لَهُ عِنْدَ اللهِ قَاتِلاً لَا يَمُوتُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الطبراني في الاوسط ورجاله ثقات مجمع الزوائد:١٠/ ٦٤٣. اَلْقَاتِلُ: اَلنَّارُ. قاله البغوي في شرح السنة:٢٩٥/١٤
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said, “Do not envy a sinner on seeing the blessings he receives, (for) you do not know what he will receive after his death. With Allah there is for him a killer that never dies” (the killer is the Fire of Jahannam in which he will stay).
